name: Creepy Woods
label: Endless Records
lede: Three Skidmore sophomores debuted at a benefit for their own zine in November 1994, and within five months a student critic named Chris Ott was hearing Slint in them. Ott also played drums in the band. They left a 7-inch, a few compilation tracks and a demo tape.

hero.by: Creepy Woods at Falstaff's, Skidmore College, c. 1995

eras.title: A benefit for Thumb
eras.text: Creepy Woods came out of Skidmore College in Saratoga Springs and out of Thumb, a student zine that the Skidmore News called "currently a music focused publication." Jon Hills played guitar and sang; Aubrey Cloutier played bass and sang, and the two share the writing credit on Almost Always.

years.cap: Jon Hills' stack of '90s demo tapes: Creepy Woods next to Frisky's Revenge, the Mysterians, Skypark, Rail and Stillmotion · Photo: Jonathan Hills
years.h: Creepy Woods debut at a Falstaff's benefit for the zine Thumb
years.p: Supernaut, Frisky's Revenge from New Jersey and the Mysterians share the bill. The Skidmore News counts three sophomores, two of them in lounge jackets, playing for about forty minutes.
years.xp:
The reviewer, writing as Stoat Mixen, called them "a smirking trio of strangelings" and heard the bass "like the soundtrack to a robot's first glimpse of consciousness."

Copies of Thumb could be had by intercampus mail to Jon Hills '97.

eras.title: Chris Ott takes notes
eras.text: The busy year: two songs on a Capital Region compilation, a 7-inch on Endless Records, and shows at Falstaff's, the campus club. Chris Ott reviewed the band twice for the Skidmore News and also played drums in it; the band goes through more than one drummer.

years.h: Two songs on Leave Your Mark, catalog number 0-90210
years.p: Endless Records' compilation of Capital Region acts carries Almost Always and Near Monday. The credits list Cloutier, Hills and a third member named only as Laura.
years.xp: Stillmotion, Johnny Boomslang and Lazarus Go Home are on it too. Near Monday runs five and a half minutes.

years.cap: Creepy Woods at Falstaff's, Skidmore College, March 31, 1995 · Photo: Lisa Primerano
years.h: "This band blew us all away," Chris Ott writes
years.p: Ott reviews a Falstaff's bill of Absalom Reload, Creepy Woods, Syrup and Stillmotion for the Skidmore News, and hears Slint in it. He notes the band has a new drummer.
years.xp:
The second song, Near Monday, "had me in total awe." The closer was Memory Bag, which isn't on any of the records: "A huge, looming wall of oppressive beauty."

His scorecard for the night: "Absalom Reload entertained me, Creepy Woods amazed me, Syrup irritated me, and Stillmotion satisfied me."

years.cap: The insert of the Almost Always 7", Endless Records, 1995
years.src: Discogs: Almost Always / Dust And Pieces
years.h: Endless Records puts Almost Always on a 7-inch
years.p: Dust And Pieces is the B-side. The insert lists aubrey on bass, jon on guitar and chris on drums, and the sleeve credits the songs to Bottle Cub Music, 1994 and 1995.
years.xp: The thank-yous run to Scheidt Audio, Stillmotion, Skypark, Rail and the Mysterians, and to "166 church st. (jon, bill, jamie, ian)." Mail went to Cloutier or Hills at Skidmore, 815 North Broadway.

years.src: Skidmore News, Oct 19, 1995 · Skidmore News, Oct 5, 1995
years.h: Rain moves the fall concert to the Case patio, for about 30 people
years.p: Creepy Woods open for campus favorites the Dank. Ott, reviewing them again, calls the set forty minutes of "precise, atmospheric pop" for fans of Seam, Codeine or old R.E.M.
years.xp:
Ott counted them among the most successful Skidmore bands, appearing "on a number of record releases by local labels (Bottle Cub, Endless)." He credited the full sound to "the complimentary interaction of the complex basslines and sparse guitar work."

A week earlier both bands were billed for the homecoming afternoon on South Park.

years.cap: Creepy Woods at Falstaff's, c. 1995; the Skidmore News ran it as a file photo with its review of the November 3 show
years.h: Cloutier drums for Skypark, then switches to bass for Creepy Woods
years.p: Boston's Secret Stars never arrive (they "ended up in the Bronx"), so it's Skypark, then Creepy Woods with Laura Scheinfeldt '96 on drums. About 50 people turn up at Falstaff's.
years.xp:
Daniel Nice's review has Hills grabbing his guitar "out of Elliot's clammy paws" after Skypark's set, Elliot being Skypark's Elliot Wheaton. He called it "ambient power pop" and singled out the "sparse yet surprisingly catchy digitally enhanced guitar licks" of "axe-master Hills."

The set included Casual and Memory Bag, which had an "almost 'La Bradford-esque' eerieness."

eras.title: A national benefit CD, then the past tense
eras.text: Creepy Woods were billed for Spring Fling in April and turned up that September on a national compilation for multiple sclerosis. By October the campus paper was listing them among the bands that came before, and Hills' next band, The Capital Suite, dates from 1996.

years.h: Creepy Woods are billed for the lawn, P-Funk for the Sports Center
years.p: Spring Fling puts Creepy Woods, the Dank and Aesop's Own on South Park from 1 to 5. At 8:30 that night, [[George Clinton|84683370-5eae-418b-acd8-883ac028a8a0]] and the P-Funk All Stars.

years.src: Discogs: Band Crazy Vol. 1 · AllMusic: Band Crazy Vol. 1
years.h: Almost Always lands on a benefit CD next to Mineral
years.p: Band Crazy Vol. 1 (Bzar Records BZ001) is a compilation of independent and unsigned bands, and "all proceeds benefit multiple sclerosis." This version was cut at Scheidt Audio in Rochester, with Matt Scheidt engineering and Chris Ott on drums.
years.xp: The Cherry Poppin' Daddies are on it too. It runs 4:18 against 4:09 on Leave Your Mark, with a different line-up credited, so it may be a different recording.

years.h: The Skidmore News files Creepy Woods under tradition
years.p: An arts column names the campus bands that came before: the Mysterians, Gulp, Aesop's Own, Creepy Woods and Matt Forsythe. Hills went on to [[The Capital Suite|9bfdd332-bfe5-4333-bb59-0882b5253b5c]] and then [[1 Mile North|b0d6108a-3dd5-479d-b518-803f54b3ba45]].
